title: Predicting response to immunotherapy in gastric cancer via assessing perineural invasion-mediated inflammation in tumor microenvironment
notes: Direct nearest neighbor that derives a PNI-mediated inflammation score from GSE214293 and already occupies a simple PNI-expression-signature route.

title: Abstract 6227: A single-cell enteric glial signature predicts poor survival in gastric cancer
notes: A 2026 conference abstract integrates six single-cell datasets and uses LASSO survival modeling; it directly weakens a simple enteric-glial signature substitution.

title: Schwann cell-derived PSAP promotes perineural invasion and metastasis of gastric cancer by activating TGF-beta1/Smad signaling
notes: Recent mechanistic neighbor linking Schwann cells to gastric PNI; study data are available from the authors rather than a fully public reusable deposit.

title: Neuron-derived MIF facilitates perineural invasion of gastric cancer via the VCAM1-CXCL8 signaling axis
notes: Recent neuron-tumor mechanism that raises the evidence bar for any causal neural claim based only on public observational transcriptomics.

title: Single-cell spatial landscape of gastric cancer reveals multicellular communities associated with patient survival
notes: Source study for the public GSE308624 CosMx cohort; valuable for spatial localization but not automatically PNI-labeled.

title: Perineural invasion affects prognosis of patients undergoing chemotherapy for advanced gastric cancer
notes: Reports pathological PNI annotation in GSE62254 and TCGA-STAD analyses; treatment association remains observational and cannot establish predictive benefit.
